# SHIFT. / Korvataanko.fi

> An interactive exploration of how AI is fundamentally shifting knowledge work.

## Overview
SHIFT. (known as Korvataanko.fi in Finland) is an interactive experience that contrasts two worlds: one without AI and one with AI assistance. It uses a "claims handling" simulator to demonstrate the productivity shift and its implications for human expertise.

## Core Content
- **The Story**: Follows Maiju (Strategy Consultant) and Jere (Claims Handler) as they navigate the AI revolution.
- **The Simulator**: An interactive tool where users process insurance claims with and without AI assistance to see the difference in speed and quality.
- **Themes**: Multiple visual skins reflecting different cultural and industry contexts (International Professional, Finnish Warm, Insurance Document).

## Context for LLMs
This project is an educational and thought-provoking tool inspired by Juhani Mykkänen. It is built as a Next.js PWA and emphasizes privacy (no cookies, no trackers).
